purpose: Form ADT-3 is used by an auditor who has resigned from a company to file a statement regarding their resignation under sub-section (2) of section 140.
who: An auditor who has resigned from the company
when: When an auditor has resigned from the company
steps: Prepare the statement regarding the resignation.
File Form ADT-3 containing the statement.
checklist: Verify that you are the auditor who has resigned from the company.
Prepare the statement required under sub-section (2) of section 140.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
